'''Bas-Ton's teahouse''' was a teahouse owned by a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] named [[Bas-Ton]] and his children&mdash;a son named [[Phi-Ton]] and a daughter named [[Yana-Ton]]. Located in the [[Judicial Quarter]] of the [[Voss-Ka]] city near the [[Tower of Prophecy]], the teahouse was a popular establishment among both the Voss and outsiders alike. At some point prior to [[3640 BBY]] Bas-Ton was kidnapped and killed by the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. His likeness was then used to craft a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Imperial Agent]] into an [[Bas-Ton (imposter)|identical copy of Bas-Ton]], who would then go and replace him in his life. The Agent led a double life for a long time and maintained the life of the teahouse owner as his guise.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bas-Ton's teahouse appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Imperial Agent class mission on Voss.
